steps.en: Start the stack with Docker Compose
steps.zh: 用 Docker Compose 启动整套服务

steps.en: Finish setup in the console and connect a model provider
steps.zh: 在控制台完成初始化，接入模型 provider

steps.en: Upload your documents into a knowledge base
Chunks, embeds and indexes them in the vector store
steps.zh: 切块、生成 embedding，写入向量库建索引

steps.en: Build the app on the Workflow canvas and publish it
steps.zh: 在 Workflow 画布上搭好应用并发布

steps.en: Per request: retrieves chunks, calls the model, runs each node, logs every step
steps.zh: 每个请求：取回文本块、调用模型、执行各节点、记录每一步

steps.en: Serves the app as a web app and a REST API with its own key
steps.zh: 把应用以网页和带独立 key 的 REST API 对外提供

value.en: Many AI apps share one workspace, knowledge base and log — no separate service to build per app
value.zh: 多个 AI 应用共用一个工作区、知识库和日志，不用每个应用单独写一个服务

sources: https://github.com/langgenius/dify#key-features (Workflow canvas, RAG pipeline, Backend-as-a-Service APIs, LLMOps logs)
docker/docker-compose.yaml and docker/.env.example (api, worker, plugin_daemon, sandbox services; VECTOR_STORE=weaviate)
